correctness.rationale: Freeness is immediate from p>2q and primeness. Tuffley Theorems 4-5 prove the cover sphere property and degree-two inclusion; connected circle rotation acts trivially on top integral cohomology. In the two-row Cartan--Leray spectral sequence of a finite-dimensional quotient, d_{2q} must map top generator to a nonzero unit in Z/p, else infinitely many base cohomology classes survive. Naturality makes the two units differ by 2. A hypothetical homotopy equivalence lifts to cover degree +/-1 and acts on H^2(BCp) by s, hence on H^{2q} by s^q; it forces 2=+/-s^{-q}. UCT gives equal integral homology. The q=2, p=5 mod 8 example uses the classical supplementary quadratic reciprocity law; finite code corroborates modular arithmetic only.

value.rationale: An infinite family of natural pairs of finite-subset filtration orbit spaces has the same fundamental group, same complete integral homology and universal covers of the same sphere homotopy type, but different homotopy types. A precise Postnikov transgression invariant distinguishes them in a structural way dictated by the inclusion of filtration stages. The all-q relationship and prime arithmetic obstruction add a meaningful new equivariant topology insight beyond the original nonequivariant result.
